theme: Chance baseline for cross-script graphic resemblance
question: How often do 42 Tamil Nadu base drawings match a declared Indus subset and two separate control inventories under the same shape descriptor?
outcome: Exploratory v2 corrects seven rows: R1 matches 30/42 Indus, 24/42 Ogham, 31/42 Tifinagh. R3S drops orientation: 4/42, 2/42, 9/42. At common n=20 R1 means are 53.70%, 57.14%, 65.11%; paired Tifinagh-minus-Indus difference 11.41 percentage points, central subset interval [-9.52,35.71]. Medium band (4-6 segments): Indus 14/15, Ogham 10/15, Tifinagh 7/15. Complete primary/reviewer agreement 52/113 (46.02%), without orientation 88/113 (77.88%). Original v1 and review retained.
challenge: Reliability is a prerequisite for resemblance rates: orientation agrees on 61/113 (53.98%) and legacy symmetry labels were not globally retraced. Three coding sets include overlays covering only 19 and 113 of 130 drawings. Six Indus exclusions, unequal complexity support and modern control glyphs limit historical interpretation. Accessible 2025 witness is a catalogued 8-page booklet; the 145-page edition remains unexamined. The Synthetic calculation is within-inventory re-drawing; the requested new random-mark generator was not built.
remedy: Preserve v1 witnesses and unadjudicated reliability; record review-informed corrections under dated amendment/run-v2. Report all nine coding combinations, paired size/subset intervals, complexity strata and exact formulas. Acquire complete matching method, traced drawings, trained-human agreement, jointly balanced historical controls and a held-out validated geometric generator before testing transmission.
retry_when: A complete method and comparison table, traced high-resolution drawings, reliable independent human coding, jointly size/complexity-balanced multi-family controls, or a geometrically validated null becomes available. Preserve v1 and v2; register further changes separately.
